title: Identifying novel p53-target genes and their functional analysis
protocol: Download p53MH algorithm from "http://linkage.rockefeller.edu/p53".
Save candidate gene sequences in .txt files within the p53MHwin folder.
Add file names to the "p53 names.txt" file.
Run the p53MH.exe program.
View potential p53 binding sites listed in "p53res.txt".
Culture H1299-WTp53 cells with 1 μg/ml tetracycline as control.
Withdraw tetracycline and culture H1299-WTp53 cells for 24 h to express wild type p53 protein.
Culture Val5 and Vm10 mouse fibroblasts at 32°C for 16 h to express wild type p53 protein.
Culture Val5 and Vm10 cells at 39°C as control condition.
Use 1×10^6 cells in a 10 cm culture dish for chromatin immunoprecipitation.
Fix cells with 1% formaldehyde and incubate for 10 min at 37°C.
Scrape fixed cells into a conical tube.
Pellet the scraped cells at 4°C.
Resuspend cell pellet in 200 μl of SDS lysis buffer provided by the ChIP assay kit.
Incubate resuspended cells on ice for 10 minutes.
Sonicate lysate to shear DNA to lengths between 200 to 1000 bp.
Dilute the sonicated cell supernatant 10 fold in ChIP dilution buffer.
Pre-clear cell supernatant with Salmon Sperm DNA/Protein A Agarose-50% Slurry for 30 min at 4°C with rotation.
Add anti-p53 antibody (FL393 for mouse cells and DO-1 for human cells) to the pre-cleared supernatant fraction.
Incubate overnight at 4°C with rotation.
Add Salmon Sperm DNA/Protein A Agarose-50% Slurry and rotate for 1 h at 4°C.
Pellet agarose by gentle centrifugation.
Wash the protein A agarose/antibody/histone complex with low salt immune complex wash buffer, one wash.
Wash the protein A agarose/antibody/histone complex with high salt immune complex wash buffer, one wash.
Wash the protein A agarose/antibody/histone complex with LiCl immune complex wash buffer, one wash.
Wash the protein A agarose/antibody/histone complex with TE buffer, two washes.
Elute the histone complex with 250 μl freshly prepared elution buffer (1% SDS, 0.1M NaHCO3) for 15 min at room temperature.
Repeat elution step to ensure complete release of histone-DNA complexes.
Add 20 μl 5M NaCl to the combined eluates.
Reverse histone-DNA crosslinks by heating at 65°C for 4 h.
Add 10 μl of 0.5M EDTA to the elutes.
Pipette 20 μl of 1M Tris-HCl, pH6.5 into the mixture.
Add 2 μl of 10 mg/ml Proteinase K to the solution.
Incubate at 45°C for 1 hour.
Recover DNA by phenol extraction.
Precipitate DNA with ethanol.
Amplify PCR fragments containing potential p53 binding elements in LIF genes using ChIP assay primers.
Clone PCR fragments into pCRII-TOPO vector.
Subclone sequence-confirmed clones into pGL2 luciferase reporter plasmids at XhoI and HindIII sites.
Screen clones by XhoI and HindIII digestion to find the correct insertion.
Confirm correct clones by sequencing.
Plate 4 × 10^5 cells per well in 6-well culture plates.
Culture cells overnight without antibiotics.
Transfect cells using a set of three plasmids: 200 ng pGL2-luciferase plasmid, 1 μg p53 expression plasmid, and 0.5 ng Renilla luciferase internal control.
Dilute the plasmid mix and the Lipofectamine 2000 reagent with Opti-MEM.
Incubate the diluted plasmids separately for 5 min at room temperature.
Combine the incubated plasmids and lipofectamine 2000, then incubate for 20 min at room temperature.
Add the mixture to each well and mix gently.
Incubate cells at 37°C for 4-6 h.
Aspirate the culture medium and replace with fresh medium.
Incubate cells for another 24 h.
Aspirate the culture medium.
Add 400 μl Passive lysis buffer to each well.
Scrape the cells and transfer into 1.5 ml tubes.
Apply 2 freeze/thaw cycles to complete lysis of cells.
Predispense 50 μl of luciferase assay reagent II into tubes.
Add 10 μl of cell lysate into each tube and read the firefly luciferase activity in a luminometer.
Add 50 μl Stop & Glo buffer into the same tube and read the Renilla luciferase activity in a luminometer.
Normalize the firefly luciferase activity from each sample with the Renilla luciferase activity from the internal control plasmid.
Extract total RNA from cells or mouse tissues with the RNeasy kit.
Treat RNA samples with DNase I to remove residual genomic DNA.
Prepare cDNA with random primers using the Taqman reverse transcription kit.

Perform real-time PCR in triplicate with Taqman PCR Mix for 15 min at 95°C for initial denaturing, followed by 40 cycles of segments of 95°C for 15 sec and 60°C for 1min in a 7000 Applied Biosystems Sequence Detection System.
Collect cell pellets and prepare cell lysates by adding RIPA buffer.
Measure the LIF protein levels using the LIF ELISA kit.
Add 50 μl of Assay Diluent RD1W to each well.
Add 50 μl of standard, control or sample per well, and incubate for 2 h at room temperature.
Aspirate each well and wash with Wash Buffer provided for 5 times.
Add 100 μl of diluted mouse LIF conjugate to each well and incubate for 2 h at room temperature.
Repeat aspirate/wash as in previous step.
Add 100 μl of Substrate solution to each well and incubate for 30 min at room temperature, protecting from light.
Add 100 μl of Stop solution to each well.
Determine the optical density of each well within 30 min using a microplate reader set to 450 nm.
Culture cells in phenol red-free culture medium supplemented with 10% charcoal-stripped FBS for 3 days.
Add various concentrations of 17-β-estradiol to cells cultured in phenol red-free culture medium supplemented with 10% charcoal-stripped FBS.
Place mice into the chamber of the irradiator for whole body irradiation.
Irradiate mice for 5 Gy using a 137Cs gamma source.
Move irradiated mice back to regular cages.
Sacrifice mice at 6 hours post-irradiation by CO2, dissect them and snap freeze collected tissues in -80°C.
Sacrifice mice by CO2, collect uterine tissues.
Place uterine tissues on an absorbable gelatin sponge soaked with DMEM supplemented with 10% FBS.
Irradiate uterine tissues for 5 Gy.
Collect irradiated uterine tissues at 6 hours post-irradiation.
Use 8-week old mice for breeding experiments.
Co-house one male mouse and one female mouse in each breeding cage for at least 6 weeks.
Check for new litters every morning starting from 19 days after setting up the breeding cages.
Calculate pregnancy rate as the ratio of females with confirmed pregnancy to total number of female mice co-housed with males.
Co-house female mice with male mice 1-2 hours before the start of the dark cycle.
Check female mice for the presence of a vaginal plug each morning, 1-2 h after the end of the dark cycle.
Designate the day that a vaginal plug is observed as pregnancy day 1.
Anesthetize pregnant female mice.
Rinse the tail with paper towels soaked in warm water to dilate the tail veins.
Inject 0.1 ml of 1% blue dye solution through a tail vein using a syringe and needle.
Sacrifice mice by CO2 inhalation 3-5 min after dye injection.
Dissect the uterus and count implantation sites as distinct blue bands along uterine horns.
Sacrifice pregnant female mice by CO2 inhalation.
Open the abdominal cavity and remove the uterus, trimming away mesometrium.
Cut between oviduct and ovary while keeping the utero-tubal junction intact.
Place uterus in M2 medium in a tissue culture dish.
Cut lengthwise through uterine-tubal junction.
Insert 26-gauge needle into cut cervix and flush each horn with approximately 0.2 ml of M2 medium.
Count blastocysts under dissecting microscope.
Pick up mouse by the scruff of its neck, close to the ears.
Pierce the skin and abdominal muscles with a hypodermic needle to inject 5 μg recombinant mouse LIF into the intraperitoneal cavity.
Repeat injection of LIF after 5 hours.
Inject an equal volume of PBS as a control.
